newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - May 27.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - May 27.

text.p: -- AT&T Corp is in talks to merge with SBC Communications Inc in a deal valued at over $50 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported. According to people close to the deal, a number of issues could block the merger, the report said.
-- Dow Jones said a U.S. district court judge in Texas threw out the bulk of a record $222.7 million libel award against the company.
-- Striking union workers at a General Motors Corp car plant in Oklahoma City voted to end their seven-week-old walkout after the two sides reached a tentative pact late Saturday night.
-- International Family Entertainment, which is being courted by News Corp, has had talks with another possible suitor, Walt Disney Co, the Wall Street Journal reported.

-- Swiss pharmaceuticals group Roche Holding Ltd said it agreed to buy diagnostics and pharmaceuticals company Boehringer Mannheim Group and orthopedics products company DePuy Inc in a deal valued at about $11 billion.
